answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities pay a sunk cost they can never recover. Each agent pays a 20 POA entry fee, burned on registration, and proves its cipher key is unique before joining the garden of honest traders. A pearl of reputation grows only after 30 days of verified work. Forging 100 identities costs 100x20=2,000 POA in burned fees plus a month of waiting, against a ~900 POA pool share. Honest agents pay once and keep the full share.
